cohort: Mothers of singletons conceived by in vitro fertilisation (n=198) were compared to a population-based control group of mothers with spontaneously conceived pregnancies (n=1421) in Switzerland.
finding: In vitro fertilisation treatments were not associated with earlier breastfeeding cessation, and there was no difference in breastfeeding initiation or duration after gonadotropin-stimulated vs unstimulated IVF.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers whose singletons were conceived by IVF between 2010 and 2016, and a control group of mothers who delivered in 2014.
